content.value_statement: Dart type and null-safety errors can delay development and cause runtime failures. This skill provides a structured workflow to analyze, fix, and verify local Dart code changes.
actual_capabilities: Runs Dart static analysis for a target project.
Uses dart fix to preview and apply supported automated fixes.
Explains fixes for null-safety, generic type, and method override errors.
Guides explicit type annotations for dynamic collection issues.
Verifies changes with dart analyze and dart test.
limitations: It focuses on Dart static analysis and common type-system issues.
It does not diagnose platform-specific Flutter build or deployment failures.
Automated fixes can change local files and should be reviewed before applying.
Passing static analysis and tests does not guarantee every runtime path is covered.

use_cases.title: Fix a null-safety error
use_cases.description: Identify nullable values and select a safe initialization, optional access, or fallback strategy.

use_cases.title: Resolve collection type errors
use_cases.description: Add explicit generic types when analyzer output reports incompatible dynamic collections.

use_cases.title: Verify a team code change
use_cases.description: Run analysis and tests after a fix before submitting a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze my project
prompt_templates.prompt: Run Dart static analysis for this project. Explain the first errors and propose minimal fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Fix null safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me resolve this Dart null-safety error. Explain whether optional access, a fallback, or initialization is appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Correct type mismatch
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this Dart type mismatch. Trace the inferred types and propose an explicit, safe type annotation.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a complete fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Dart error fix. Run static analysis and tests, summarize results, and identify any remaining failures.

output_examples.input: A List<dynamic> cannot be passed to a method expecting List<int>.
output: Create the collection with an explicit int type.
Run Dart analysis and tests to verify the change.

output_examples.input: A non-nullable instance field is not initialized.
output: Check whether the field can be nullable.
Use a constructor initializer when possible.
Use late only when initialization before every read is guaranteed.

best_practices: Run dart fix with dry-run before applying changes.
Prefer explicit types and constructor initialization over unsafe casts or late fields.
Run dart analyze and dart test after every fix.
anti_patterns: Do not apply automated fixes without reviewing the proposed changes.
Do not use a null assertion when a value can be absent.
Do not silence analyzer errors with broad casts that hide invalid runtime types.

faq.question: What errors does this skill address?
faq.answer: It addresses common Dart static analysis errors involving types, null safety, generics, and method overrides.

faq.question: Does it change my files automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide dart fix usage. Review the dry-run output before applying changes.

faq.question: Should I use late for every uninitialized field?
faq.answer: No. Use late only when every code path initializes the field before it is read.

faq.question: Why run dart analyze after dart fix?
faq.answer: Automated fixes do not resolve every issue. Analysis identifies remaining errors.

faq.question: Why run tests after static analysis passes?
faq.answer: Tests can reveal behavior problems that static analysis does not cover.

faq.question: Does this skill fix all Flutter errors?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Dart analysis issues, not all platform, build, or deployment errors.
